title: Maternity Leave Residency Scheduling | Rebuilt For You
description: Maternity leave residency scheduling, handled. Our managed service rebuilds the schedule around a resident's leave, with coverage and fairness held, and nothing for your chief to redo.
h1: Maternity Leave Residency Scheduling Without the Headache
paragraph: Stop manually rebuilding schedules for maternity leave. Send us the leave details and your rules; we rebuild the schedule around it and send it back finished.

cta.title: Stop Rebuilding Schedules Around Leave
cta.description: Book a call to talk through your scheduling needs and learn how Scheduling Wizard works. Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices that have us build their call, block, clinic and shift schedules.

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard rebuilds your affected schedules when a resident goes on maternity leave. You submit the updated rules (including the leave details, duration, and any coverage preferences) and our team redistributes rotations, call assignments, and clinic coverage across your remaining residents. The output is a revised schedule, built to the same rules, ready to publish, without your team manually rebuilding anything from scratch.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard handle maternity leave in a residency program?

faq.answer: Yes. We apply the duty hour rules as we rebuild rather than checking afterwards. Even with coverage thinner, the 80-hour average, the rest requirements and your subspecialty's rules are part of the rebuild, and if anything needs to change once the program reviews it, we redraft.
faq.question: Will ACGME compliance be maintained when a resident is on maternity leave?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard redistributes call, weekend, and holiday burden across the remaining residents when someone is on maternity leave. Rather than manually assigning extra shifts to whoever is available, our team balances the additional load equitably across the cohort, minimizing any single resident's disproportionate burden.
faq.question: How do you ensure fair call distribution when one resident is on leave?

faq.answer: Maternity leave typically creates downstream changes across block rotations, call schedules, clinic assignments, and sometimes attending schedules. Scheduling Wizard builds all of these together. Because our team resolves cross-schedule dependencies together, a change in call coverage propagates correctly into rotation and clinic schedules rather than creating new conflicts downstream.
faq.question: What schedule types are affected by maternity leave and does SW handle all of them?

faq.answer: Programs submit their scheduling rules, rotation requirements, ACGME rules, resident preferences, coverage minimums, and the specifics of the maternity leave (dates, affected resident, any accommodation requirements). Scheduling Wizard builds the schedule from there and delivers the finished schedule as Excel or Google Sheets, or on a custom live view we build for you, ready for whatever platform you already use.
faq.question: What does the program need to submit to get a revised schedule?

faq.answer: Manual scheduling in Excel requires someone, typically a chief resident, to hand-check every affected rotation, call slot, and clinic assignment for conflicts and compliance after each change. Scheduling Wizard replaces that process entirely. Our team handles the rule checking and redistribution, and institutional scheduling knowledge persists with Scheduling Wizard year over year, so a new chief does not have to relearn how your program's rules work.
faq.question: How is Scheduling Wizard different from managing maternity leave manually in Excel?
